approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content, with file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
notes: Reproduce a question naming one Drawing and one Specification that recognizes only the Specification and leaves Drawing evidence as OTHER.
Add Drawing to the existing bounded source-family comparison path rather than creating another retrieval service or index.

Recognize an explicit Drawing/Sheet/Dwg/Detail identifier or plural drawing-set wording while keeping a generic singular sheet lookup ordinary and Shop Drawing mapped to Submittal unless the question separately names another drawing source.

Classify drawing evidence conservatively from an exact Sheet locator, native CAD extension, explicit drawing file name, or a line-leading drawing marker after Email, RFI, Submittal and Specification checks.
Keep model-vision narration excluded from project questions and make no provider request.
title: Add Drawing to project-question source comparisons
objective: Make Drawing a first-class, conservatively detected source family in file-grounded comparisons alongside Specification, RFI, Submittal and Email.
